get_node_label: get the DOT rendering label string for a given BMGNode type in the BeanMachine compiler graph
get_node_error_label: get the human-readable error description label for a given BMGNode type in the BeanMachine compiler
get_edge_labels: get the list of edge input labels for all inputs of a given BMGNode in the compiler graph
get_edge_label: get the edge input label at a specific index for a given BMGNode in the compiler graph
tensor_to_label: convert a PyTorch tensor to a formatted string label representation for graph visualization
